description: This Python script sets up a chatbot leveraging Google Gemini Live LLM API with multiple transport configurations (Daily, Twilio, WebRTC). It manages a conversational pipeline with context handling, user interaction, and responses, specifically oriented towards providing recent news and current date information using Google search API. It includes environment configuration, external service integrations, and event handlers for client connection management.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: A service class that interfaces with the Google Gemini Live LLM API, initialized with API key, voice ID, system instructions, and tools.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: A class representing the context or history of the conversation used for the LLM processing.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A class for aggregating and managing user and assistant responses within the conversation context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Encapsulates the sequence of processing stages for the conversational flow.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a processing task within the pipeline, including parameters and timeout settings.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms handling communication between user and bot.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Configuration class for the 'daily' transport setup.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration class for the 'twilio' transport setup, based on FastAPI WebSocket.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and runner arguments, initializing the LLM and processing pipeline, handling client connection events.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot process.
